verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows a way to plug an external coding agent into a Bolt project so it drives the builder. The docs describe only Bolt's own Standard and Max agents. MCP connectors make Bolt the client, not a host for outside agents. GitHub sync could let a user run another agent on the repo, but that is a user-side workaround, not a product capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect my own coding agent to the project so it drives the builder alongside or instead of the built-in one
